theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Big Banks is the cleanest eligible non-crowded leader: durable trend tag, positive breadth, and uncrowded. It offers a lower-extension complement to the crowded energy leader while staying inside the validated trend gate.
theses.dissent: Canada's banks are macro-rate-sensitive and could lag if domestic growth slows or credit concerns rise; relative strength is modest and this is an attention lens, not alpha.

theses.subject: Technology
theses.thesis: Canadian tech is crowded (z=1.51) with mixed trend health and a limited liquidity universe — the detector's crowding-as-size-down caution argues for staying on the sidelines until extension clears, especially with AI-tech macro narrative dominating headlines (a possible attention top for the related theme).
theses.dissent: AI/manic tech flow could keep driving XIT.TO higher despite crowding; avoiding the leader of a reflexive, dense headline theme risks missing continuation.

falsifier.text: XIT.TO clears the crowding flag (z back below 1.0) while holding eligibility before the check-by.
